text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cyprus Amax Minerals has invested $5 million in the first phase of the exploration and drilling at Kansanshi mine.
- Thieves have dug up graves in Lusaka to steal blankets from exhumed bodies.
- The farmers union has urged the government to view it not as an automatic opposition but as a partner in development.
- The Ministry of Foreign Affairs said it recalled diplomatic staff from Lubumbashi in Zaire for security reasons.
- An association for the blind says it will join a campaign for aid cuts against Zambia unless the government addresses its concerns.
- The government has urged members of the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa and the Southern African Development Community to attend Zambia's international trade fair.
